messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm starting a phased rollout for model v8.1 now. Targets: EU: 2% -> 10% -> 40% over 3 steps; NA: 1% -> 5% -> 20%. :rocket:

maya: Guardrails: abort if error-rate increases >0.5pp vs baseline OR p95 latency +30% OR token-cost jitter >15%. Also fallback path goes to v7.9 stable.

sam: Nice. Can you paste the feature-flag name and the rollout config? I want to add it to the release notes. :memo:

maya: Flag is ff/model:v8-1 (service flag). Rollout config snippet:
```
{"slices": [{"region":"eu","steps":[{"pct":2,"duration":"30m"},{"pct":10,"duration":"2h"},{"pct":40,"duration":"6h"}]},{"region":"na","steps":[{"pct":1,"duration":"30m"},{"pct":5,"duration":"3h"},{"pct":20,"duration":"6h"}]}],"abort_conditions": {"error_rate_pp": 0.5, "p95_delta_pct": 30}}
```

leo: Thanks — adding to the infra runbook. Which dashboards should oncall watch?

maya: Primary: /dashboards/model/v8/latency-and-errors, secondary: /dashboards/quality/prompt-regressions. Also look at eval-set hallucination slider (daily).

oncall-sre: Got it. I'll set temporary alert thresholds matching the abort_conditions and add an ephemeral Pager duty for the next 12 hours. Will also enable request sampling on the EU pool.

arjun: Pushed a client routing tweak that pins retries to the stable pool for 5m after a 500. Should avoid double-fail storms during the first step.

sam: One quick question — can we include a narrow audience slice for internal beta in EU (team-only) before the public 2% step? If easy I'd prefer that.

maya: Good call. I'll add a pre-step: EU-internal 0.2% (internal users) for 20m right before the 2% step. Updating config now.

deploy-bot: deployment job started for ff/model:v8-1 on namespace=production, run=deploy-2026-03-17-01. CI checks all green.

leo: Also note we should keep the canary logs retained for 72h (not usual 24h) for the first day. I'll open a retention tweak PR.

oncall-sre: Confirmed alerts set, retention overridden to 72h for those log groups. I'll post links once they're live.

maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. If you see anything weird ping me asap. Otherwise I'll wait 30m after EU-internal then flip the public 2% step. :eyes:

arjun: :thumbsup: watching logs and traces.

sam: LGTM, no objections from product.

maya: Rolling over to step-1 in 15m (after a short cooldown)
